title: Done-gate
line: Ask for evidence when the agent says it’s done.

beats.caption: You ask for a runnable example.
Done-gate sends the model a verification reminder.
beats.label: pi-done-gate

beats.caption: The agent runs the repository’s check.
The check runs the new example.

aside.title: What the model sees
aside.note: Captured from the model request in this recording.

takeaway.title: Ask for evidence
takeaway.line: A repository check gives the agent a way to verify its work.

title.text: An agent can finish an edit and miss the check that would tell you if it works.

scene.text: The agent adds an example and calls it done. Done-gate sends a reminder to the model. That card shows the actual reminder. The agent then runs the repository’s own check, which includes the example.

takeaway.text: If your repository has a verification recipe, Done-gate can point the agent to it before it wraps up.
